help.hero_subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions
help.buying_q1: How do I find the right car?
help.buying_a1: Use the advanced search with filters by brand, model, year, price and other parameters. Save searches to get notified about new listings.
help.buying_q2: How do I contact a seller?
help.buying_a2: Each listing page has a 'Contact seller' button. You can send a message directly or make a price offer.
help.buying_q3: How do I add a car to favorites?
help.buying_a3: Click the heart icon on the car card or listing page. All favorite cars are available in your dashboard.
help.buying_q4: How do I check a car's history?
help.buying_a4: Ask the seller for the VIN number and check the history through official services. Also check the Service Book section in the listing.
help.selling_q1: How do I post a listing?
help.selling_a1: Click 'Post an ad' in the header. Fill in the 5-step form: basic info, technical specs, location, photos and description.
help.selling_a2: Basic listing costs €9.99 for 30 days. You can additionally order a Boost (search ranking) or TOP SPOT (homepage placement).
help.selling_q3: How do I change the listing price?
help.selling_a3: In your dashboard, find the listing and click 'Edit price'. Prices can be changed no more than once every 3 days.
help.selling_q4: How do I delete or mark as sold?
help.selling_a4: In your dashboard under 'My listings', find the listing and choose 'Remove' or 'Mark as sold'.
help.account_a1: Click 'Sign in' in the top right and choose a registration method. You can use email or log in via social networks.
help.account_q2: How do I edit my profile?
help.account_a2: Go to your dashboard → Settings tab. There you can change your name, phone, city and preferred language.
help.account_q3: How do I set up notifications?
help.account_a3: In profile settings there is a Notifications section where you can enable or disable email notifications about new listings, price drops and messages.
help.dealers_q1: How do I become a dealer on the platform?
help.dealers_a1: Go to the 'For dealers' page and fill in the dealership registration form. After review you will get access to the dealer panel.
help.dealers_q2: What pricing plans exist for dealers?
help.dealers_a2: We offer three plans: Starter (up to 5 cars), Pro (up to 50 cars) and Premium (unlimited). Details on the pricing page.
help.dealers_a3: AI leads are automatically identified potential buyers based on their behavior on the platform. Available on the Premium plan.
help.safety_a1: Never send prepayment to strangers. Meet in public places to inspect the car. Check the VIN and documents. Use the built-in chat for communication.
help.safety_q2: How do I report a listing?
help.safety_a2: On the listing page click 'Report' and specify the reason. Moderators will review the complaint within 24 hours.
help.safety_q3: Is it safe to leave my data on the site?
help.safety_a3: We use encryption and secure connections. Your data is not shared with third parties without consent. See the Privacy Policy for details.
help.payments_a1: We accept Visa and Mastercard bank cards. Payment is processed through a secure payment system.
help.payments_a2: Refunds are possible within 14 days if the listing was not published. After publication, funds are non-refundable.
help.payments_q3: How do I get a payment receipt?
help.payments_a3: A payment receipt is automatically sent to your email after a successful transaction.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to your questions
faq.contact_desc: Write to our support and we'll be happy to help.
faq.a_payment: We accept bank cards (Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay) and bank transfers for corporate clients.
faq.q_dealer_plans: What pricing plans are available for dealers?
faq.a_dealer_plans: We offer three plans: Starter, Pro and Premium. Details on the dealer pricing page.
faq.a_register: Click 'Sign in' in the top right corner and follow the instructions. You can use email or Google for quick registration.
faq.q_become_dealer: How do I register as a dealer?
faq.a_become_dealer: Go to Dealer Register, fill in the company form — after review you'll get access to the Dealer Dashboard.
faq.q_dealer_cost: How much does it cost to work on the platform for dealers?
faq.a_dealer_cost: Pricing plans are in the Dealer Pricing section. There are packages for different volumes of listings and advertising tools.
faq.q_manage_leads: How do I manage listings and leads?
faq.a_manage_leads: In your Dealer Dashboard you can see all active listings, incoming requests (leads), tasks and communication with buyers.
faq.a_promote: In the Advertising section there are paid tools: highlighting in the catalog, priority display and banner advertising.
faq.q_countries: In which countries does CarUnity operate?
faq.a_countries: The platform covers Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia — a single marketplace for the entire Baltic region.
